install.description: Adds the InfluxData apt repository, installs telegraf, writes the InfluxDB v2 output configuration and the 0600 token file, then restarts the service. No-op when already in place.
install.title: Install Telegraf

uninstall.description: Removes the configuration and token file, purges telegraf and removes the apt repository. No-op when not installed.
uninstall.title: Uninstall Telegraf

update.description: Upgrades telegraf and restarts the service. No-op when current.
update.title: Update Telegraf

verify.description: Read-only check that the service is active and the configuration and token file are in place with the right permissions. Exits non-zero when it is not.
verify.title: Verify Telegraf

description: Installs and manages the Telegraf agent from the InfluxData apt repository, configured to ship metrics to an InfluxDB 2.x instance. The API token is a vault secret written to a 0600 file that the plugin reads via token_file; it never appears in the configuration. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: telegraf
title: Telegraf
